name: Nighttime Conflagration AP

stealth.note: (trained) (decreases by 2 each round the hazard is active) to smell the smoke and hear the crackling flames

disable: DC 27 Athletics to beat out the flames, DC 27 Crafting to rig up a firefighting device, or DC 27 Nature to cut off avenues of the fire's spread. On a success, one square of the fire is extinguished (two squares on a critical success). Dousing a square in water, such as with create water, automatically extinguishes that square. When all squares are extinguished, the hazard ends.
routine: (1+ actions) Each square of flames spreads to an adjacent square, taking one action per square. Creatures adjacent to the fire take 3d6 Fire Damage damage each round from the heat (Basic DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw save); a creature who fails their save is Sickened 1 by the smoke (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). If there are more than 10 active squares of flames, creatures adjacent to the fire instead take 6d6 Fire Damage damage each round (Basic DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw save), and a creature who fails their save is sickened 2 (Sickened 3 on a critical failure). A creature standing in the flames takes 12d6 Fire Damage damage each round (Basic DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save); a creature who fails their save also takes 4d6 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Growing Blaze
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The arsonists set the fire

Effect The hay around the initial flames catches, setting two 5-foot squares in the affected room on fire. The hazard rolls initiative.
